summary: Recovered the sanitized adversarial correction benchmark and made it an enforced allocator regression instead of a dormant test. The fixture contains exactly 12 semantic correction classes and excludes raw private conversation and hidden reasoning. Against the current compiled-dispatch structural validator, 4 classes are anticipated by baseline structure; Specification Assurance adds 4 contextual classes, yielding 8/12 combined pre-dispatch anticipation. Four residual semantic misses remain intentionally visible rather than being scored away: MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT, NO_HUMAN_DISPATCH, DYNAMIC_CHILD_SUBCOMPILE and NO_FAKE_CONTINUATION_GATE. Contextual negative controls report 0 false-positive violations across 4 tested question constraints. Patched the existing Live Feed allocator workflow to execute agentic_adversarial_correction_benchmark_v1.mjs after the compiled-dispatch gate. GitHub Actions run 37023516993 completed the full allocator-build step successfully with the benchmark wired in. No benchmark scheduler, authority or architecture promotion was added.
